name: Switch
summary: Binary toggle for an immediate-effect setting. Pill track + sliding thumb. Distinct from Toggle (button-style on/off) and Checkbox (form-submission boolean). Built on Radix Switch.

rules: Always paired with a visible label.
Switch state takes effect IMMEDIATELY (no submit). If the action requires confirmation, use a Checkbox + submit instead.
Touch target extends to the label.

do: Use Switch for settings that take effect immediately (notifications on/off, dark mode).
Show a brief confirmation for destructive toggles ('Disabled — emails will stop within 24h').
Pair with a description when the toggle has non-obvious side effects.
dont: Don't use Switch for form-submission booleans — use Checkbox.
Don't use Switch as a 'Save / Cancel' toggle — that's a Button group.

changelog.note: Initial dedicated contract — Switch was previously conflated with the Toggle component (which is now reserved for the button-style on/off pattern, e.g. left-rail filter toggles).
